<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt"><B>MineralRite
Announces FINRA&rsquo;s Processing of the Form 211 Filed by Its Sponsoring Broker-Dealer</B></FONT> <I>DALLAS, Texas &mdash; November
6, 2026</I> &mdash; MineralRite Corporation (OTC: RITE) today announced that on November 5, 2026, the Company&rsquo;s sponsoring broker-dealer
(the &ldquo;Sponsor&rdquo;) informed the Company that the Sponsor had received notice from the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority
(&ldquo;FINRA&rdquo;) that FINRA had processed the Form 211 filed by the Sponsor under Securities and Exchange Commission (&ldquo;SEC&rdquo;)
Rule 15c2-11, which means that the Sponsor has demonstrated to FINRA compliance with FINRA Rule 6432 and may initiate priced quotations
for RITE common stock in the over-the-counter market.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>What FINRA&rsquo;s processing of the Form 211
means</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Before FINRA processed the Form 211, RITE common
stock carried the &ldquo;Unsolicited Quotes Only&rdquo; designation, under which quotations were limited to those representing unsolicited
customer orders. On November 6, 2026, OTC Markets removed the "This security is eligible for Unsolicited Quotes Only" warning from RITE's profile page. OTC Markets has informed the Company that the "Unsolicited Quotes Only" designation shown under Quote Eligibility for RITE on the OTC Markets site will be removed on the trading day after the Sponsor publishes its first priced quotation. Other broker-dealers may
also quote RITE common stock to the extent permitted by Rule 15c2-11.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">FINRA's processing of a Form 211 relates solely to the Sponsor's compliance with FINRA Rule 6432 and SEC Rule 15c2-11, and is not to be deemed an approval of the Company, its securities, or its business. Each brokerage firm sets its own policies regarding
the securities it will accept and the orders it will handle. There can be no assurance that any broker-dealer will publish or continue
to publish quotations for RITE common stock, or that an active or liquid trading market will develop or be sustained.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Corporate and business milestones since October
2023</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">FINRA&rsquo;s processing of the Form 211 follows
a series of corporate and business milestones completed since James Burgauer assumed management of the Company in October 2023, including:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>February &ndash; March 2024</B>
&mdash; Acquired the worldwide rights to brand, build and sell the Goldfield brand of gold mining equipment, including the Prospector,
Explorer and Goldtron Tables product lines and their blueprints, together with the remaining equipment, inventory, spare parts and tools
formerly used in the business of Goldfield International, Inc.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>September 2024</B> &mdash; Released
financial statements for fiscal years 2022 and 2023 audited by a PCAOB-registered independent accounting firm. The Company&rsquo;s financial
statements for fiscal years 2024 and 2025 have also been audited by the same PCAOB-registered independent accounting firm.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>December 2024</B> &mdash; Acquired,
from NMC, Inc., Peeples Inc., which holds the Arizona State Land Department mineral lease covering the previously processed tailings at
the Skull Valley project in Arizona, and California Precious Metals LLC, which holds 17 BLM mining claims comprising the Silver Valley
and La Escondida properties in California.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>February 2025</B> &mdash; Filed
a Form 10 registration statement with the SEC to become a fully reporting company. Engaged its investment banker and sponsoring broker-dealer.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>March 2025 </B>&mdash; Obtained
the Alberta Securities Commission&rsquo;s revocation of a cease-trade order that had been in place since 2013.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: right">&nbsp;<IMG SRC="logo2.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>April 2025</B> &mdash; FINRA completed
its processing of the corporate action related to the Company&rsquo;s redomicile to Texas.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>September 2025</B> &mdash; Announced
that RITE common stock is exempt from the definition of &ldquo;penny stock&rdquo; under SEC rules.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>November 2025</B> &mdash; Engaged
an independent Qualified Person under SEC Regulation S-K Subpart 1300 for the Skull Valley project.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>January 2026</B> &mdash; Completed
the execution of a successor lease with the Arizona State Land Department for the Skull Valley project, with the required reclamation
bond in place.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>June 2026</B> &mdash; The SEC staff
completed its review of RITE&rsquo;s Form 10 registration statement. Additionally, following its Qualified Person&rsquo;s Phase 1 review,
RITE announced its intention to advance the Skull Valley project to a Phase 2 verification and analytical program.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>September 2026</B> &mdash; Repurchased
approximately 3.9 million Series NMC Preferred shares from a related party, reducing potential dilution by approximately 2 billion common-equivalent
shares compared with exercise of the Series NMC warrants without a repurchase, and capped the total amount payable under the Series NMC
sinking fund at approximately $269 million.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><B>November 2026</B> &mdash; The Sponsor
informed the Company that FINRA had processed the Form 211 filed by the Sponsor under SEC Rule 15c2-11, and OTC Markets removed the "This security is eligible for Unsolicited Quotes Only" warning from RITE's profile page.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Work in progress</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Several key business initiatives remain under
way, including:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD><B>Skull
Valley Phase 2:</B> the drilling and sampling program is currently scheduled to begin in mid-November 2026 under the supervision of the
Company&rsquo;s Qualified Person, with drilling expected to be completed in early December.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>


<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD><B>Asset
development:</B> the Company continues to explore ways to realize value from its Arizona mineral lease and California mining claims,
and to evaluate additional remediation and resource-recovery opportunities involving previously processed materials, which management
believes can reduce environmental impact compared with greenfield mining.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>


<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD><B>Financing
and new business:</B> the Company continues to evaluate new business opportunities, including the development of a precious metals business,
and to obtain financing on terms management believes are appropriate.</TD></TR></TABLE>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Management Commentary</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&ldquo;With FINRA&rsquo;s processing of the Form
211, we have completed the corporate cleanup we set out to do when I took over the Company in October 2023,&rdquo; said James Burgauer,
President and CEO of MineralRite Corporation. &ldquo;Even as we were completing that work, we registered as a Crafted Precious Metals
Dealer in our home state of Texas, successfully onboarded the Company with multiple refineries, and set up our RITE Precious Metals LLC
subsidiary. Skull Valley remains front and center for us. Our independent Qualified Person is overseeing the Phase 2 program, and our
goal is a technical report that meets the SEC&rsquo;s S-K 1300 standards. As we have from day one, we will keep shareholders informed
of our progress through our Investor Relations page and our other public disclosures, including our SEC filings.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">---</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>About MineralRite Corporation</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">MineralRite Corporation is focused on the evaluation,
remediation, recycling, and potential recovery of mineral values from existing materials, including previously processed mine tailings
and other resource-bearing substrates. The Company&rsquo;s strategy is centered on resource recovery and monetization from existing materials,
rather than greenfield mining exploration or development activities. The Company believes this approach may represent a more efficient
path toward potential operations and may allow for reduced upfront capital commitments through a more staged investment profile. Traditional
greenfield exploration and development projects can require significant capital expenditure prior to the confirmation of any recoverable
resources. Even with this approach, outcomes will depend on technical, economic, and regulatory factors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company is in the early stages of development
and has not yet established any mineral resources or reserves under SEC Regulation S-K Subpart 1300, nor does it currently have any revenue-generating
operations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Contact:</B><BR>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #3B3838"><U>Safe Harbor Disclosure</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #3B3838">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #3B3838"><B><I>Forward-Looking Statements</I></B>:
Certain information set forth in this communication contains &ldquo;forward-looking statements&rdquo; within the meaning of applicable
U.S. federal securities laws, including Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &quot;Securities Act&quot;), and Section
21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &quot;Exchange Act&quot;). MineralRite Corporation&rsquo;s common stock is
exempt from the definition of &ldquo;penny stock&rdquo; under Section 3(a)(51) of the Exchange Act and Rule 3a51-1 promulgated thereunder.
Accordingly, the statutory safe harbor provisions of Section 21E of the Exchange Act are available to the Company with respect to forward-looking
statements made herein. Nonetheless, investors are cautioned that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties,
and other factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied by such statements. The Company
also relies upon applicable common-law protections, including the &ldquo;bespeaks caution&rdquo; doctrine, together with the meaningful
cautionary statements contained herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #3B3838">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #3B3838">Except for statements of historical
fact, certain information contained in this communication constitutes forward-looking statements, including, without limitation, statements
concerning the matters discussed herein; the Company&rsquo;s current and planned projects, operations, business opportunities and strategic
initiatives; financing, development and monetization activities; regulatory and market-related matters; and management&rsquo;s expectations,
beliefs, assumptions, objectives and plans.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #3B3838">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: rgb(59,56,56)">The Company is in the early stages
of development, has not established any mineral resources or mineral reserves under SEC Regulation S-K Subpart 1300, and currently has
no revenue-generating operations. The Company has limited capital resources, and there can be no assurance that the Company will have
sufficient funding to achieve its objectives or to continue operations; the Company may need to obtain additional financing, which may
not be available on acceptable terms or at all. Mineral exploration, resource recovery, remediation, recycling, and related operations
involve substantial risks and uncertainties, including technical, operational, metallurgical, environmental, permitting, regulatory, financing,
commodity-price, liquidity, and market-related risks. The Company's evaluation of the Skull Valley project relies in part on historical
third-party technical data that has not been fully independently verified, and the Company was unable to contact all historical analytical
groups associated with prior work. The limited sampling conducted during Phase 1 is not representative of the tailings as a whole and
may not be indicative of results achievable in Phase 2 or at scale. The timing of the Skull Valley Phase 2 program depends on the availability
of the Company&rsquo;s Qualified Person, drilling contractors and analytical laboratories and may be delayed, and there can be no assurance
that a technical report meeting the requirements of SEC Regulation S-K Subpart 1300 will be completed or will support the establishment
of any mineral resources or reserves. There can be no assurance that any broker-dealer will continue to publish quotations for RITE common
stock or that the &ldquo;Unsolicited Quotes Only&rdquo; designation will not be reinstated. Projects involving the reprocessing of previously
processed tailings materials are subject to additional uncertainties, including variability in material composition, prior processing
impacts on recoverability, and limited comparability with greenfield mineral deposits. There can be no assurance that the Company will
successfully implement its business plans, obtain necessary financing or permits, achieve operational objectives, establish economically</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #3B3838">&nbsp;</P>
